mapper.select: SELECT Rp_Date, Rp_Number, Rp_Flag, Rp_SeFlag, (SELECT Hc_Name FROM I_HelpCD WHERE Hc_Code = 'Int000095' AND Hc_Seq = Rp_SeFlag) AS seFlagNm, Rp_Buser, dbo.GetBuserNm(Rp_Buser) as buserNm, Rp_OrRemark, Rp_SaFlag, Rp_UserID, dbo.GetSaNm(Rp_UserID) AS userNm, Rp_Sign1, Rp_ReUserID, dbo.GetSaNm(Rp_ReUserID) AS reUserNm, Rp_ReDate, Rp_JobUserID, dbo.GetSaNm(Rp_JobUserID) AS jobUserNm, Rp_ReRemark, Rp_ReFlag = ISNULL(Rp_ReFlag, 1) , cc_ReFlag = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Rp_ReFlag, 1) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, Rp_EXDate, Rp_EXUserID, Rp_Sign2, Rp_RegDate, Rp_ImgNum = ISNULL(Rp_ImgNum, '') FROM I_Repair WHERE rp_Date >= #{searchFromDate} AND rp_Date <= #{searchToDate} AND rp_buser = #{searchBuserCd} AND UPPER(Rp_OrRemark) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%' ORDER BY Rp_Date DESC
